$comment: Policy for scripts/sync/automerge.mjs, which merges registry sync PRs that pass every safety check. Changing this file is a governance change that needs Joshua Small's approval. Pause without a PR: set the repository variable AUTOMERGE_PAUSED=true, add the 'hold' label to one PR, or disable the Auto-merge registry sync workflow.

requiredCheckSource.$comment: Required checks count only when created by this GitHub App (15368 = GitHub Actions) for the exact head, in a check suite of a run of this workflow file. A same-named check from any other app or workflow cannot satisfy them.
